title: NPC
description: A non-player character entity. One entity per file, conventionally content/npcs/<id>.json.

sprite.description: Path to the NPC's sprite asset, relative to the content package root.

dialogueTreeId.description: References a content/dialogues/*.json entity of type "dialogueTree" started when this NPC is talked to.

interactions.description: Script(s) run when the player interacts with this NPC (e.g. on-look). Talking normally starts dialogueTreeId rather than running a script directly.
